title: Anatomy atlas, MRI (AI)
description: Anatomy outlines for the Learn-mode anatomy layer (layer 'atlas') on MRI series: the arteries of the Circle of Willis on the time-of-flight MR angiograms of brain-mra, with A1/A2, P1/P2 and M1/M2 segments where the junction is seen, after automatic QC and a visual check of every case. Not reviewed by a radiologist; never used for grading. No images: targets reference those packs' series and SOP UIDs.

sources.name: Horalix (horalix.com)
sources.license: AI-generated drafts for this app; the segmentation tools and their licences are listed in docs/data/anatomy-atlas-mr-report.md
sources.citation: Thanks to Horalix.com, every structure in the anatomy layer is marked. The outlines are AI, not reviewed by a radiologist.
sources.accessNote: Unreviewed AI drafts; never used for grading.

sources.name: Lausanne TOF-MRA Aneurysm Cohort (Lausanne University Hospital, CHUV)
sources.citation: Di Noto T, Marie G, Tourbier S, Aleman-Gomez Y, Esteban O, Saliou G, Bach Cuadra M, Hagmann P, Richiardi J. Towards automated brain aneurysm detection in TOF-MRA: open data, weak labels, and anatomical knowledge. Neuroinformatics. 2023;21:21-34. doi:10.1007/s12021-022-09597-0. Data: OpenNeuro doi:10.18112/openneuro.ds003949.v1.0.0
sources.accessNote: TOF-MRA (anat/*_angio.nii.gz + JSON sidecar) and derivatives/manual_masks/*_desc-Lesion_*_mask.nii.gz of the selected subjects downloaded anonymously from the public OpenNeuro S3 bucket (s3://openneuro.org/ds003949, version 1.0.0).

sources.name: TopCoW challenge: Circle of Willis annotations of external MRA test sets (Lausanne controls and IXI-HH)
sources.license: Circle-of-Willis labels: TopCoW data terms, as defined by OpenData Swiss: "Open use. Must provide the source. Use for commercial purposes requires permission of the data owner." Images: CC0 1.0 (Lausanne cohort) and CC BY-SA 3.0 (IXI; the derived DICOM is shared under the same licence).
sources.citation: Yang K, Musio F, Ma Y, Juchler N, Paetzold JC, Al-Maskari R, et al., Menze B. Benchmarking the CoW with the TopCoW challenge: topology-aware anatomical segmentation of the Circle of Willis for CTA and MRA. arXiv:2312.17670. Data: Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.15692630. Images: Di Noto T et al., Neuroinformatics 2023 (Lausanne, CC0); IXI dataset, brain-development.org (CC BY-SA 3.0).
sources.accessNote: MRA_Lausanne.zip and MRA_IXI_HH.zip downloaded from the open Zenodo record 15692630 (MD5 checked against the record): raw/raw_imgs (images as distributed by the original datasets), raw/cow_seg_labels_for_raw_imgs (the challenge's masks mapped back to those images by the organisers) and antpos_edges_labelsTr (presence of each segment).
